function shouldBeAllowedToCallInPatientLocalCustom() {
	currentService = CellValue(''CURRENT_ENCOUNTERLOCATIONRESHID'',''value'');
	//For multiple LokRESH then add && between each currentService. (currentService != "999922" && currentService != "999921" && currentService != "999923")
	CheckIn = CellValue(''PATIENT_CHECKIN_TIME'',''value'');
	Dropinstatus = CellValue(''CURRENT_SERVICE_STATUS_DROPIN'',''value'');
    currentStatus = CellValue(''CURRENT_SERVICE_STATUS'',''value'');
	CheckInEmpty = isEmpty(CheckIn)
	
	// Checks for conditions that should allow for patient being called in.
	if (!CheckInEmpty) && (currentStatus == "Vent" || currentStatus == "Gå til") {
		return true;
	}
	
	// Checks that patient has not yet registered, and status is not completed or expired.
	if (CheckInEmpty && (currentStatus == "Ferdig" || currentStatus == "Utgått")) {
		return false;
	}
	
	// Compares current service RESH to configured RESH of the clinic
	if (currentService != "replaceReshId") {
		alert("Denne pasienten har en anen pågående timeavtale.");
		return false;
	}
	// Checks status for blood sampling, returns their boolean value
	if (Dropinstatus === "Gå til" || Dropinstatus === "Vent" || Dropinstatus === "Klargjøres") {
		alert("Denne pasienten er til blodprøvetaking, og er straks klar.");
		return false;

	if (currentStatus == "Indirekte") {
		return true;
	}
	console.warn("Function [shouldBeAllowedToCallInPatientLocalCustom] triggered default fallback FALSE. Check function file for possible misconfiguration.");
